lessons.title: What it actually is
lessons.summary: Pattern-matching at enormous scale — not understanding, not magic, and not a person.
objectives: You will explain prediction from patterns in your own words
You will name three things these systems do well
You will name three they do badly
lessons.body:
## What to do

- Play a prediction game: the class guesses the next word in a sentence
- Discuss what the system is actually doing — statistics over examples
- List what it is good at and bad at

## Practise at home

1. Explain to someone at home what these systems are, without the word "magic"
1. Write down one thing you expected it could do that it cannot

- **If this is new to you:** Do the paper version of the exercise before the computer version. If you cannot do it by hand, the computer is doing it for you, not with you.
